Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: our procurement team needs the latest Type II report (redacted copies are fine) and a point of contact for any follow-up control questions.
- SSO: we use Okta and need confirmation that Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC; screenshots of the IdP setup would be helpful.
- SCIM: we’ll want the SCIM provisioning guide and any rate-limit/attribute mapping constraints.
- RBAC/admin controls: please describe built-in roles, ability to create custom roles, and the audit logging retention period.

I’ve attached the vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx our security team prefers — can you populate the IAM section and return? Target for us is to complete our review by the end of next week.

Subject: Re: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 follow-up

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the checklist — I’ve filled out the IAM tab in your questionnaire (see attached vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx) and attached the artifacts we discussed. Quick summary below; full details in the attachments and the shared Drive link.

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security & Availability) in 2026. We can provide a redacted PDF (SOC2-report-2026.pdf). For control clarifications, Rishi (cc’d) is our security lead and can handle follow-ups.

SSO / SAML / OIDC:
- We support SAML 2.0 and OIDC.
- IdP screenshots and example metadata are in sso-setup-guide.pdf.
- Typical setup: create a SAML app in Okta, set ACS URL and Entity ID per the guide, upload Redwood metadata.

SCIM provisioning:
- Full SCIM 2.0 support for user provisioning/deprovisioning.
- scim-provisioning-guide.xlsx covers attribute mappings, bulk sync considerations, and rate limits (100 reqs/min by default; can be increased for enterprise Dedicated customers).

RBAC & admin controls:
- Built-in roles: Admin, Developer, Billing, ReadOnly.
- Custom role support: yes (scope-based permissions, resource-level assignments).
- Audit logs: immutable audit stream with 13 months retention by default; extended retention available as an add-on.
- MFA requirement: enforced for Admin role; recommended for Developer role.

Attachments included:
- SOC2-report-2026.pdf (redacted)
- sso-setup-guide.pdf
- scim-provisioning-guide.xlsx
- completed_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (IAM tab filled)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/IAM-evidence/DEAL-4721

If you want, Rishi and I can hop on a 30-min call with your security team to walk through the artifacts and answer technical questions.

Best,

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
